notes.title: 3.10: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in Hapland 1 Second Quest where the landmine would not behave properly if knocked down into the cave.
[*] Fixed a bug where the introductory "what to do" hint was not shown before playing Hapland 1, instead showing a black screen for the equivalent amount of time.
[*] Fixed general bugginess of the "Toggle Full Screen" option.
[*] Fixed a bug where the audio would skip or sounds would cut off early on some computers.
[*] Fixed a bug on the "Complete" screen where the decorative black zigzags had accidentally been made 1% transparent.
[/list]

notes.title: 3.09: Minor bug fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Hapland 1[list]
[*] Adjusted the timing of the crate dog sequence, making it slightly more lenient, and fixing  a bug where the man would sometimes die when the animation made it look like he shouldn't.
[/list]
[*]Hapland 1 Second Quest[list]
[*] Added a dot to the red bomb, making it possible to tell the bombs apart without being able to distinguish red and green colours.
[*] Fixed a bug where the man in the cave could sometimes survive the red bomb's explosion, if he was standing in certain spots.
[*] Fixed a bug where if you fired the stone and then the red bomb at the bell, the red bomb would disappear and not explode.
[/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added Korean localization.
[*] Secret bug fixes.
[/list]
